en: Hello {contact}, the handover session on {item} for {project} is planned for {due}. Please confirm who attends from {to_whom}.
mt: Halo {contact}, sesi penyerahan pada {item} untuk {project} direncanakan untuk {due}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {contact} {item} {project} {due} {to_whom}

en: Hello {contact}, the benefits review for {project} is on {review}, in about {months_left} months. Please keep the latest figures for {benefit} ready.
mt: Halo {contact}, ulasan manfaat untuk {project} adalah pada {review}, sekitar {months_left} bulan.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {contact} {project} {review} {months_left} {benefit}

en: Hello {tester}, test cycle {cycle_id} ({cycle}, round {round}) on {project} starts on {date}. Please prepare {planned} cases and the test data.
mt: Halo {tester}, siklus uji {cycle_id} ({cycle}, putaran {round}) pada {project} dimulai pada {date}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {tester} {cycle_id} {cycle} {round} {project} {date} {planned}

en: Hello, deliverable {name} on {project} has waited {waiting} days for the client. The decision was due by {decide_by}. Please call {contact}.
mt: Halo, deliverable {name} pada {project} telah menunggu {waiting} hari untuk klien.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {name} {project} {waiting} {decide_by} {contact}

en: Hello, closure task "{task}" on {project} is owned by {owner} and is due on {due}. It is {days_late} days late if it shows a number. Please check it.
mt: Halo, tugas penutupan "{task}" pada {project} dimiliki oleh {owner} dan jatuh tempo pada {due}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {task} {project} {owner} {due} {days_late}

en: Hello {sponsor}, benefit "{benefit}" of {project} is at {achieved} of the planned level. The next review is on {review}. Please look at the actions needed.
mt: Halo {sponsor}, manfaat "{benefit}" dari {project} adalah pada {achieved} dari tingkat yang direncanakan.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {sponsor} {benefit} {project} {achieved} {review}

en: Hello {support_owner}, I am sending the access and contacts list for {service} on {project}. Please check your accounts before {start}. Handover items done: {handover_done}.
mt: Halo {support_owner}, saya mengirim akses dan daftar kontak untuk {service} pada {project}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {support_owner} {service} {project} {start} {handover_done}

en: Hello, milestone {milestone} on {project} was accepted on {accepted_on}. Please invoice {amount} to {contact}. The client terms are {terms} days.
mt: Halo, milestone {milestone} pada {project} diterima pada {accepted_on}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {milestone} {project} {accepted_on} {amount} {contact} {terms}

en: Hello, the post-project review response {pr_id} for {project} from {respondent} is ready. Main lesson: {lesson}. Please add it to the library.
mt: Halo, jawaban review pasca proyek {pr_id} untuk {project} dari {respondent} sudah siap.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {pr_id} {project} {respondent} {lesson}

en: The payment tied to this acceptance is {col:deliverables.payment_due}. The acceptance check shows: {col:deliverables.state}.
mt: Pembayaran yang terkait dengan penerimaan ini adalah {col:deliverables.payment_due}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:deliverables.payment_due} {col:deliverables.state}

en: The pass rate needed to leave the cycle is {set:pass_exit}. The check shows: {col:cycles.state}.
mt: Tingkat lulus yang diperlukan untuk meninggalkan siklus adalah {set:pass_exit}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {set:pass_exit} {col:cycles.state}

en: The client terms are {col:payments.terms} days. The invoice number is {col:payments.invoice_no}, sent on {col:payments.invoice_date}, due on {col:payments.due}. The payment check shows: {col:payments.check}.
mt: Istilah klien adalah {col:payments.terms} hari. Nomor faktur adalah {col:payments.invoice_no}, dikirim pada {col:payments.invoice_date}, jatuh tempo pada {col:payments.due}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:payments.terms} {col:payments.invoice_no} {col:payments.invoice_date} {col:payments.due} {col:payments.check}

en: Support is taken over by {col:transition.support_owner}, telephone {col:transition.support_phone}, from {col:transition.start}. The handover status is {col:transition.status}.
mt: Dukungan diambil alih oleh {col:transition.support_owner}, telepon {col:transition.support_phone}, dari {col:transition.start}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:transition.support_owner} {col:transition.support_phone} {col:transition.start} {col:transition.status}

en: The benefit check shows: {col:benefits.state}. The next review is on {col:benefits.review}. The review check shows: {col:benefits.review_state}.
mt: Periksa manfaat menunjukkan: {col:benefits.state}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:benefits.state} {col:benefits.review} {col:benefits.review_state}

en: The budget now is {col:projects.budget_now} and {col:projects.spent} was spent. The rework share of effort is {col:projects.rework_share}.
mt: Anggaran sekarang adalah {col:projects.budget_now} dan {col:projects.spent} telah dibelanjakan.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:projects.budget_now} {col:projects.spent} {col:projects.rework_share}

en: Ratings from 1 to 5: schedule {col:ppr.schedule}, cost {col:ppr.cost}, scope {col:ppr.scope} and client {col:ppr.client}. The overall rating is {col:ppr.overall}.
mt: Peringkat dari 1 sampai 5: jadwal {col:ppr.schedule}, biaya {col:ppr.cost}, ruang lingkup {col:ppr.scope} dan klien {col:ppr.client}.
why: placeholders must be exactly: {col:ppr.schedule} {col:ppr.cost} {col:ppr.scope} {col:ppr.client} {col:ppr.overall}
